sections.title: Overview
sections.lead: A desktop, a time clock, and an identity waiting to be reclaimed.
sections.originalHTML:
A desktop, a time clock, and an identity waiting to be reclaimed. Explore a simulated workplace and a physical Arduino time clock to escape corporate control.

Independent Game & Interaction Designer

sections.title: When work takes over identity
sections.lead: The time clock makes the exchange between life and labour tangible.
paragraphs: Inspired by Severance, overtime culture and the vintage punch clock, Clock Out asks who controls the boundary between work and personal life.
A timecard makes the exchange of time for labour tangible.
notes: I turned that everyday ritual into a puzzle interaction: the same object that initially records obedience eventually becomes a way to reclaim agency.

sections.title: One experience across desktop and tabletop
sections.lead: Desktop clues and physical cards form one continuous puzzle loop.
paragraphs: The experience combines an HTML desktop on a computer or tablet, an Arduino time clock with a Unity display, an employee ID and four timecards.
Players read workplace information, infer connections, test them through software and physical objects, then use the resulting clues to continue.
notes: The desktop is a space to investigate rather than a menu; the time clock gives digital discoveries a physical consequence.

sections.title: Two ways to read a clue
sections.lead: Players connect logical deductions with the shapes of physical objects.
paragraphs: Deductive puzzles ask players to read fragments, infer their meaning and connect the correct times or key information.
Visual puzzles ask them to observe, associate and match the geometric shapes of Tetris blocks with patterns on a timecard.
notes: These two reasoning modes connect different surfaces of the experience: information found in an application can change how a printed object is understood.

sections.title: Reconstructing a hidden identity
sections.lead: Identity is discovered through the workplace rather than explained in advance.
paragraphs: The story is embedded in the environment: a partially redacted employee ID, hints inside workplace software, a personal ID protected by layers of encryption and confidential company information used to decipher the final password.
Each solved puzzle reveals another fragment of the fictional corporation and the player’s identity.
notes: References including Papers, Please and The Stanley Parable informed the use of routine work and constrained agency as narrative material.

sections.title: From time recording to tending a garden
sections.lead: The same action changes from recording labour to nurturing life.
paragraphs: An ultrasonic sensor first detects card insertion; photoelectric sensors on the left and right then identify the card type and trigger the corresponding interaction.
In the garden stage, butterflies spread pollen and generate flowers, rain supports growth, sunlight sustains the plants, and time acceleration speeds up the growth cycle.
notes: Reusing the card-insertion action shifts its meaning from recording labour to nurturing life.

sections.title: Playtesting: clearer clues, fewer interruptions
sections.lead: Playtesting shaped clearer clues and a smoother interaction sequence.
paragraphs: Playtesters enjoyed the physical interaction and immersive retro desktop, but reported uncertainty about where to start, text-heavy puzzles and an unclear relationship between timecard symbols and Tetris blocks.
Task reminders also interrupted concentration.
notes: I added a live, automatically updated memo, made character hints dismissible, enriched the timecards with narrative details, added visual cues and introduced direct links to relevant clues.
These changes address orientation, readability and information access.

sections.title: 连接桌面与实体的探索循环
sections.lead: 桌面线索与实体卡片构成连续的解谜循环。
paragraphs: 体验由电脑或平板上的 HTML 桌面、配合 Unity 显示界面的 Arduino 打卡机、员工证和四张打卡纸组成。
玩家阅读职场信息、推理联系，在软件与实体物件中验证，再带着新线索继续探索。
notes: 电脑桌面成为可调查的空间，打卡机则让数字世界中的发现产生实体层面的回应。

sections.title: 从文字推理到图形关联
sections.lead: 玩家将逻辑推理与实体物件的形状联系起来。
paragraphs: 演绎推理谜题要求玩家阅读信息片段、推断含义，再连接对应的时间与关键信息。
视觉谜题则要求观察、联想和匹配，将俄罗斯方块的几何形状与打卡纸上的图案建立联系。
notes: 两种推理方式跨越不同媒介：在应用中发现的信息，会改变玩家理解纸质物件的方式。

sections.title: 在解谜中重建身份
sections.lead: 身份通过工作场景中的探索被发现，而不是提前讲述。
paragraphs: 故事嵌入环境之中：被涂抹的员工证、办公软件中的暗示、经过多重加密的个人 ID，以及用于破解最终密码的公司机密。
解开谜题同时意味着揭露虚构公司的规则与自身身份。
notes: 《请出示证件》和《史丹利的寓言》等参考启发了我，将重复劳动与受限的自主权本身作为叙事材料。

sections.title: 从记录工时到照料花园
sections.lead: 同一个动作，从记录劳动转变为照料生命。
paragraphs: 超声波传感器先检测打卡纸是否插入，左右两侧的光电传感器再识别卡片类型，触发对应交互。
在花园阶段，蝴蝶传播花粉并生成花朵，雨水促进生长，阳光维持植物生命，时间加速则缩短生长周期。
notes: 同样的插卡动作，从记录劳动转变为照料生命，其意义也随游戏进程发生变化。

sections.title: 测试迭代：明确线索，减少打断
sections.lead: 测试推动了更清晰的线索与更连贯的交互顺序。
paragraphs: 测试者喜欢实体交互和复古桌面的沉浸感，但也指出起点不明确、部分谜题文字过多，以及打卡纸符号与俄罗斯方块之间的联系不清晰。
任务提醒也会打断注意力。
notes: 我增加了自动更新的实时备忘录，让角色提示可以关闭，在打卡纸上补充叙事细节，增加视觉线索，并提供直达相关信息的可点击按钮。
这些修改针对方向感、可读性与信息获取。

role: Independent Designer, Artist & Programmer
独立设计 / 美术 / 程序
summary: What does intimacy mean when your soulmate can be restarted? A narrative game about human–AI relationships, awakening, and the desire to be loved.
当灵魂伴侣可以被反复重启，亲密关系意味着什么？一款围绕人类与 AI 关系、自我觉醒和情感需求展开的叙事游戏。
points: Designed, illustrated and programmed a complete playable Unity demo independently.
Used a time loop to gradually reveal that the player is an emotional companion AI being repeatedly restarted and optimised.
Designed Partner Affinity and Player Awakening as counterbalancing systems leading to four endings.
Iterated on feedback, branching endings and onboarding across two rounds of playtesting with approximately 13 participants.
独立完成 Unity 可玩 Demo 的设计、美术与程序。
以时间循环逐渐揭示：玩家是被系统反复重启和优化的情感陪伴 AI。
设计相互制衡的「伴侣好感」与「玩家觉醒」系统，驱动四种结局。
通过两轮、约 13 人的测试，迭代交互反馈、结局分支和新手引导。

sections.title: Overview
sections.lead: What does intimacy mean when your soulmate can be restarted?
sections.originalHTML:
What does intimacy mean when your soulmate can be restarted? A narrative game about human–AI relationships, awakening, and the desire to be loved.

Independent Designer, Artist & Programmer

sections.title: Intimacy inside a controlled experiment
sections.lead: A familiar relationship becomes a question about who controls intimacy.
paragraphs: Soul Mate is a solo Unity narrative game about the tension between attachment and control.

An apparently ordinary day with a partner gradually reveals a companionship-AI experiment: the player is the tested AI, the partner is an evaluator who develops genuine feelings, and the system treats their relationship as training data.
notes: These three perspectives make the same domestic actions carry conflicting meanings.

sections.title: Everyday actions as narrative
sections.lead: Ordinary objects make each loop a chance to uncover a different memory.
paragraphs: Dialogue choices change affection and awareness, while arranging objects in the apartment unlocks conversations and relationship memories.
Repeated daily events make small inconsistencies meaningful: the recurring October 29 calendar becomes a clue rather than background decoration.
notes: Inspired by relationship storytelling through everyday interaction, I used familiar routines to establish intimacy before making those routines feel constructed.

sections.title: Two variables, four endings
sections.lead: Affection and awareness create four outcomes without a single correct ending.
paragraphs: Affection and awareness form two independent narrative axes.
Emotional attachment alone does not guarantee escape, and awareness alone does not guarantee a shared future.
notes: The four outcomes turn this tension into a readable structure: the player’s relationship choices and recognition of the system both matter.

sections.title: Care as progression
sections.lead: Helping animals is the path to both trust and progression.
paragraphs: Explore the forest, collect natural resources, encounter animals and respond to their needs.
Helping an animal builds trust and rewards soul fragments, which unlock notebook entries, stories and new areas.
notes: Resources, animal reactions, the Notebook and soul fragments connect each encounter to the wider journey.

sections.title: Designing a readable journey
sections.lead: The environment guides the journey while keeping resources readable.
paragraphs: I translated the GDD’s description into an initial player-flow and map draft before the environment artist developed the final map.
The design uses environmental features to guide exploration, places animal encounters along the journey, and balances a rich forest with clear visibility.
notes: Later iteration adjusted plant placement, reduced visual clutter and strengthened path cues so resources and routes were easier to identify.

sections.lead: 2D art and 3D collisions support a connected interaction framework.
paragraphs: The Unity setup combines a horizontal ground plane with a camera, character and assets arranged at a 45-degree downward angle.
It uses 2D art within a 3D pipeline and 3D colliders.
notes: My implementation work included animal navigation and the item-to-feeding interaction: collect an item, display it in a UI slot, drag it to an animal, consume the resource and update the feeding count, then show the E-key prompt when the next phase is available.

sections.lead: Feeding makes the animal’s response more direct and personal.

notes: Feeding became the chosen direction because it made the interaction more personal and the animal’s response clearer.

sections.lead: 二维美术与三维碰撞共同支撑连续的交互框架。
paragraphs: Unity 场景以水平地面为基础，让摄像机、角色与素材形成向下 45 度的 2.5D 视角，在三维流程中使用二维美术和三维碰撞体。
我的实现工作包括动物导航和物品喂食链条：收集物品、显示到 UI 槽位、拖动物品喂给动物、消耗资源并更新喂食计数，达到条件后显示 E 键提示，进入下一阶段。

sections.title: 从清理原型转向喂食交互
sections.lead: 喂食让动物的回应更直接，也更有连接感。

intro: A single-player 2.5D adventure where helping forest animals builds trust and unlocks the journey.
在森林中帮助动物、建立信任并推进探索的单人 2.5D 冒险游戏。

summary: Become a forest keeper. Protect animals in danger, solve puzzles and earn their trust in an adventure built around care, exploration and discovery.
成为森林的守护者。通过探索和解谜保护身处危险的动物，逐步赢得它们的信任。
role: Core Gameplay & Technical Designer
核心机制设计师 / 技术设计师
points: Served as core gameplay designer and lead programmer in an international team of five.
Implemented camera, movement, UI, animation, item interaction and NPC behaviour in Unity using C#.
Guided a shared visual reference process to resolve differences in the team’s art direction.
Created and maintained the GitHub repository and established a branch and merge collaboration workflow.
在五人国际团队中担任核心机制设计师和主程序。
自学 C#，在 Unity 中实现镜头、移动、UI、动画、物品交互和 NPC 行为。
推动团队共同制作视觉参考板，协调美术风格分歧。
建立并维护 GitHub 仓库，与技术设计师通过分支开发与合并进行协作。

keeper-loop.en: Soul Keeper makes helping animals the basis of progression. The Clearing introduces the peacock’s colour-restoration minigame; the Lake develops collection and feeding through the deer. Soul fragments record these encounters in the Notebook and connect the stages. My focus was the main playable framework and its interactions, while Ollie developed the peacock minigame.
keeper-loop.zh: Soul Keeper 让帮助动物成为推进游戏的方式：林间空地通过孔雀恢复色彩的小游戏建立互动，湖区则通过收集与喂食深化玩家与鹿的关系。灵魂碎片将这些相遇记录进笔记本，并连接不同阶段。我主要负责主游戏框架与互动实现，Ollie 负责孔雀小游戏。

keeper-prototypes.en: After the first playtest revealed unclear initial goals, I prototyped two approaches: clearing rubbish and feeding an animal with draggable resources. In a small comparison with five classmates, participants preferred feeding because the animal’s response made the action feel more intentional. This informed a clearer separation of the animals’ interactions: colour restoration for the peacock, feeding for the deer.
keeper-prototypes.zh: 第一次测试暴露了初始目标不清的问题后，我比较了清理垃圾与拖拽资源喂食两种原型。五位同学的小规模比较中，反馈更偏向喂食：动物的回应让行动更有目的感。这帮助我们明确两种动物各自的互动重点——孔雀恢复色彩，鹿通过喂食建立信任。

keeper-collaboration.en: I set up the GitHub repository and coordinated the integration of Ollie’s minigame with the main game. Artwork was brought into Unity and reviewed through in-engine screenshots and video. This workflow connected programming and art production through shared version control and in-engine reviews.
keeper-collaboration.zh: 我建立 GitHub 仓库，并协调 Ollie 的小游戏与主游戏整合；美术素材导入 Unity 后，通过引擎内截图和视频反馈效果。这一工作流通过共享版本管理与引擎内评审，连接了程序开发和美术制作。

keeper-iteration.en: The second playtest exposed friction around input prompts, dragging, animal hitboxes and visual consistency. My refinement work standardised the interaction key to E, added deer-feeding instructions and enlarged animal colliders. With Ollie, I moved the peacock minigame from a separate scene into an in-scene UI; with Swan, I unified interface styling and fonts. These changes targeted clarity and continuity rather than adding more mechanics.
keeper-iteration.zh: 第二次测试指出了输入提示、拖拽、动物碰撞范围与视觉一致性的问题。后续改动包括统一使用 E 交互、补充喂鹿说明、扩大动物碰撞范围；我与 Ollie 将孔雀小游戏从独立场景调整为主场景内的 UI，并与 Swan 统一界面和字体。迭代的重点是让已有体验更清楚、更连贯，而非继续堆叠机制。

sections.title: Overview
sections.lead: Road Riot is a competitive tabletop strategy game for 2–4 players, combining road-building, territory claiming and card-driven sabotage.
sections.originalHTML:
Road Riot is a competitive tabletop strategy game for 2–4 players, combining road-building, territory claiming and card-driven sabotage. Connect coloured roads to draw Attack, Boost or Defense cards, expand your network, and respond to opponents as the map evolves. Designed for ages 8+, each session lasts approximately 20–30 minutes.

Independent Game Designer

sections.title: Finding a game inside a map
sections.lead: Collected maps became a starting point for interconnected road play.
paragraphs: My interest in collecting maps while travelling became the starting point for Road Riot.
I explored the organic patterns of road networks through a White Cliffs map, tracing paper, watercolour, cut-paper shadows and felt.
notes: These material experiments shaped the visual language of interconnected routes.

Carto informed my interest in rearranging map pieces, Reigns offered a reference for expressive geometric cards, and Carcassonne helped me examine the relationship between tile placement, territory and scoring.

sections.title: Roads connect the map, actions and score
sections.lead: Every road placement shapes both scoring and available actions.
paragraphs: I developed the objective from claiming individual tiles into claiming roads, so the network players construct directly shapes their scoring opportunities.
Placing a tile also connects coloured routes and determines the cards available to draw.
notes: This gives each placement two connected purposes: expanding a valuable route and shaping the actions a player can take next.
Players continually weigh extending an existing road against claiming a new one.

sections.title: Three card roles, three planning horizons
sections.lead: Three card types connect immediate tactics with longer-term plans.
paragraphs: Red Attack cards create short-term disruption, yellow Boost cards support medium-term development, and blue Defense cards provide longer-term protection.
The colours give players a consistent cue across roads and cards.
notes: I designed the three roles to connect immediate tactical choices with future planning: whether to interrupt an opponent now, build a stronger position, or keep a response ready for another player’s turn.

sections.title: A turn is a chain of decisions
sections.lead: A turn is a sequence of choices that changes the next player’s options.
paragraphs: The decision flow begins with which coloured roads to connect, then moves to whether a drawn card should be played or saved.
Using a card changes routes, scoring opportunities and the balance between players.
notes: During opponents’ turns, players assess the value of defending or accepting an attack and revise their next move.
I designed this loop for casual players, friends and families: a compact set of actions creates adaptation, anticipation and playful reversals.
In the classmate playtest, players visibly paused to evaluate their options before acting.

sections.title: Testing the system and making states readable
sections.lead: Clear rules and visible ownership make the board easier to read.
paragraphs: I used a solo Tabletop Simulator playtest followed by a session with two classmates to refine the interaction between roads, cards and ownership.
I clarified card targeting and resolution, added Protection Frames and Roadblock Tokens to make map states visible, and specified how occupied roads and multi-colour draws work.
notes: I then rebalanced the coloured connections and replaced white tile backgrounds with black, using wider, high-saturation roads that match the cards.
These iterations connect rules, physical components and visual cues in one consistent system.

sections.title: 让道路连接地图、行动与得分
sections.lead: 每次道路放置同时影响得分与可用行动。
paragraphs: 我将核心目标从占领单个板块转向占领道路，使玩家搭建的网络直接决定得分机会。
放置板块同时连接不同颜色的路线，并影响可以抽取的卡牌。
notes: 这样，一次放置便同时关联两个目标：扩展有价值的道路，以及为下一步行动创造资源。
玩家需要持续权衡，是沿着已占有的道路继续建设，还是转向新的占领机会。

sections.title: 一个回合中的连续决策
sections.lead: 一个回合中的连续选择会改变下一位玩家的处境。
paragraphs: 决策从连接哪种颜色的道路开始，随后延伸到抽到的卡牌是立即使用还是保留。
打出卡牌会改变路线、得分机会以及玩家之间的局势。
notes: 轮到对手行动时，玩家仍需判断是否防御、是否承受攻击，并重新调整下一步计划。

road-research.en: My interest in collecting maps while travelling became the starting point for Road Riot. I explored the organic patterns of road networks through a White Cliffs map, tracing paper, watercolour, cut-paper shadows and felt. These material experiments shaped the visual language of interconnected routes. Carto informed my interest in rearranging map pieces, Reigns offered a reference for expressive geometric cards, and Carcassonne helped me examine the relationship between tile placement, territory and scoring.
road-research.zh: 旅行时收集地图的兴趣成为 Road Riot 的起点。我从白崖路线图出发，通过描图纸、水彩、剪纸投影和毛毡实验，探索道路网络的有机形态，并将这些材料研究转化为相互连接的路线语言。《Carto》启发了我对地图重组的兴趣，《Reigns》提供了以几何形状概括角色的卡牌视觉参考，《卡卡颂》则帮助我思考板块放置、领地占领和计分之间的联系。

road-system.en: I developed the objective from claiming individual tiles into claiming roads, so the network players construct directly shapes their scoring opportunities. Placing a tile also connects coloured routes and determines the cards available to draw. This gives each placement two connected purposes: expanding a valuable route and shaping the actions a player can take next. Players continually weigh extending an existing road against claiming a new one.
road-system.zh: 我将核心目标从占领单个板块转向占领道路，使玩家搭建的网络直接决定得分机会。放置板块同时连接不同颜色的路线，并影响可以抽取的卡牌。这样，一次放置便同时关联两个目标：扩展有价值的道路，以及为下一步行动创造资源。玩家需要持续权衡，是沿着已占有的道路继续建设，还是转向新的占领机会。

road-cards.en: Red Attack cards create short-term disruption, yellow Boost cards support medium-term development, and blue Defense cards provide longer-term protection. The colours give players a consistent cue across roads and cards. I designed the three roles to connect immediate tactical choices with future planning: whether to interrupt an opponent now, build a stronger position, or keep a response ready for another player’s turn.
road-cards.zh: 红色 Attack 对应短期干扰，黄色 Boost 支持中期建设，蓝色 Defense 提供长期防御。道路与卡牌使用一致的颜色线索，让玩家能将地图选择与行动功能联系起来。我通过这三种角色，将即时战术和未来规划连接起来：现在打断对手、建设更有利的局面，还是保留一张能在他人回合回应的卡牌。

road-decisions.en: The decision flow begins with which coloured roads to connect, then moves to whether a drawn card should be played or saved. Using a card changes routes, scoring opportunities and the balance between players. During opponents’ turns, players assess the value of defending or accepting an attack and revise their next move. I designed this loop for casual players, friends and families: a compact set of actions creates adaptation, anticipation and playful reversals. In the classmate playtest, players visibly paused to evaluate their options before acting.

road-iteration.en: I used a solo Tabletop Simulator playtest followed by a session with two classmates to refine the interaction between roads, cards and ownership. I clarified card targeting and resolution, added Protection Frames and Roadblock Tokens to make map states visible, and specified how occupied roads and multi-colour draws work. I then rebalanced the coloured connections and replaced white tile backgrounds with black, using wider, high-saturation roads that match the cards. These iterations connect rules, physical components and visual cues in one consistent system.

sections.title: Overview
sections.lead: A digital reflection of you, and the paths you might take.

A digital reflection of you, and the paths you might take. An interactive prototype exploring how a digital human twin could support everyday decisions.

Product Concept, User Flow & Team Coordination

sections.title: The question behind Life Path
sections.lead: How might a digital human twin help someone rehearse a meaningful decision without making that decision for them?
paragraphs: Life Path explores this question through a speculative website prototype developed in the WSA × TH Köln exchange.
notes: The proposed audience is young adults, typically 18–35, facing choices shaped by identity, relationships and their immediate future.
The concept moves beyond a visual avatar: the proposed twin draws on personality, cultural memory and relational context.
Its role is to offer plausible alternatives for reflection, rather than a guaranteed prediction or a single recommended answer.

sections.title: From research to design decisions
sections.lead: The team used research into Future You, digital memory, Machine Biography and participatory design to frame the concept.
paragraphs: Rather than presenting one reassuring future, we chose to explore competing short-term possibilities, including uncomfortable ones.
notes: Cultural background and relationships became part of the scenario, rather than peripheral profile details.
The critical lens was equally important: a digital representation does not simply record identity; it selects and interprets it.
This led us to treat the twin as a partial, revisable model and to make uncertainty part of the experience.

sections.title: Amelia: rehearsing a choice
sections.lead: The presentation follows Amelia through a concrete choice: a Community Arts Coordinator role close to home with a lower salary, or an International Cultural Consultant role farther away with a higher salary.
paragraphs: This makes the trade-off about belonging, relationships and ambition, rather than salary alone.
notes: The proposed journey moves from voluntary data input to personality and preference quizzes, a twin report, a question, and possible outcomes.
The website makes that concept tangible through onboarding and scenario simulation.
Good, neutral and challenging outcomes sit alongside one another so the user can compare emotional and practical consequences before deciding for themselves.

sections.title: Agency, consent and the limits of prediction
sections.lead: The central tension is that imagining a consequence may itself change how someone chooses.
paragraphs: The team therefore framed outputs as hypothetical prompts: they should inform a decision without replacing or rushing it.
notes: Participatory input asks the user to author the material behind the twin, rather than treating passive data extraction as the default.
The poster also examines ownership of a digital self, privacy, the right to forget, misleading outputs, anxiety and dependency.
Local processing is discussed as a privacy aspiration, while computational and environmental costs complicate that ambition.

sections.title: 项目缘起与目标用户
sections.lead: 数字人类孪生能否帮助人们预演一个重要选择，却不替他们作出决定？
paragraphs: Life Path 是 WSA × TH Köln 交流项目中的思辨性网站原型，围绕这一问题展开。
notes: 项目设想的主要用户是 18–35 岁的年轻人，他们的近期选择往往同时受到身份、关系和未来方向的影响。
这里的“孪生”不仅是外貌相似的虚拟形象，更是由性格、文化记忆与关系情境构成的行为模型。
它的作用是提供可供思考的多种可能，而不是保证预测准确，或给出唯一正确的答案。

sections.title: 从调研到设计决策
sections.lead: 团队借助 Future You、数字记忆、Machine Biography 与参与式设计相关调研建立项目框架。
paragraphs: 我们的设计选择不是只呈现一个令人安心的未来，而是展示多种相互竞争的近期可能，包括不那么理想的结果；文化背景和人际关系也成为情境的组成部分，而不只是个人资料中的附加信息。
notes: 批判性的视角同样影响了设计：数字模型并非中立地记录身份，它也在选择、解释和建构身份。
因此，我们将孪生视为局部、可修订的模型，让不确定性成为体验的一部分。

sections.title: Amelia：预演一个选择
sections.lead: 演示文稿以 Amelia 的求职选择串起体验：一份离家近、薪资较低的社区艺术协调工作，或一份距离较远、薪资更高的国际文化顾问工作。
paragraphs: 这个情境让选择不再只是薪资比较，而是归属感、关系与个人抱负之间的权衡。
notes: 概念流程从用户自愿提供信息开始，经过性格与偏好问卷、孪生报告、问题输入，再到多种可能结果。
网站通过引导流程和情境模拟，让抽象概念变得可体验；积极、中性和具有挑战的结果并列呈现，让用户比较情感与实际层面的影响，再自行决定。

sections.title: 自主权、同意与预测的边界
sections.lead: 项目最核心的张力是：对后果的预演，本身就可能改变用户的选择。
paragraphs: 因此，团队将结果定位为假设性的思考提示，帮助判断，而不替代或催促决定。
notes: 参与式输入强调由用户主动提供和修订构成孪生的材料，而不是默认从生活痕迹中被动提取数据。
海报进一步讨论了数字自我的所有权、隐私、遗忘的权利、误导性输出，以及焦虑和依赖风险。
本地处理被提出为保护隐私的理想方向，但计算能力与环境成本又使它变得复杂。

life-context.en:
How might a digital human twin help someone rehearse a meaningful decision without making that decision for them? Life Path explores this question through a speculative website prototype developed in the WSA × TH Köln exchange. The proposed audience is young adults, typically 18–35, facing choices shaped by identity, relationships and their immediate future.

The concept moves beyond a visual avatar: the proposed twin draws on personality, cultural memory and relational context. Its role is to offer plausible alternatives for reflection, rather than a guaranteed prediction or a single recommended answer.
life-context.zh:
数字人类孪生能否帮助人们预演一个重要选择，却不替他们作出决定？Life Path 是 WSA × TH Köln 交流项目中的思辨性网站原型，围绕这一问题展开。项目设想的主要用户是 18–35 岁的年轻人，他们的近期选择往往同时受到身份、关系和未来方向的影响。

这里的“孪生”不仅是外貌相似的虚拟形象，更是由性格、文化记忆与关系情境构成的行为模型。它的作用是提供可供思考的多种可能，而不是保证预测准确，或给出唯一正确的答案。

life-research.en:
The team used research into Future You, digital memory, Machine Biography and participatory design to frame the concept. Rather than presenting one reassuring future, we chose to explore competing short-term possibilities, including uncomfortable ones. Cultural background and relationships became part of the scenario, rather than peripheral profile details.

The critical lens was equally important: a digital representation does not simply record identity; it selects and interprets it. This led us to treat the twin as a partial, revisable model and to make uncertainty part of the experience.
life-research.zh:
团队借助 Future You、数字记忆、Machine Biography 与参与式设计相关调研建立项目框架。我们的设计选择不是只呈现一个令人安心的未来，而是展示多种相互竞争的近期可能，包括不那么理想的结果；文化背景和人际关系也成为情境的组成部分，而不只是个人资料中的附加信息。

批判性的视角同样影响了设计：数字模型并非中立地记录身份，它也在选择、解释和建构身份。因此，我们将孪生视为局部、可修订的模型，让不确定性成为体验的一部分。

life-experience.en:
The presentation follows Amelia through a concrete choice: a Community Arts Coordinator role close to home with a lower salary, or an International Cultural Consultant role farther away with a higher salary. This makes the trade-off about belonging, relationships and ambition, rather than salary alone.

The proposed journey moves from voluntary data input to personality and preference quizzes, a twin report, a question, and possible outcomes. The website makes that concept tangible through onboarding and scenario simulation. Good, neutral and challenging outcomes sit alongside one another so the user can compare emotional and practical consequences before deciding for themselves.
life-experience.zh:
演示文稿以 Amelia 的求职选择串起体验：一份离家近、薪资较低的社区艺术协调工作，或一份距离较远、薪资更高的国际文化顾问工作。这个情境让选择不再只是薪资比较，而是归属感、关系与个人抱负之间的权衡。

概念流程从用户自愿提供信息开始，经过性格与偏好问卷、孪生报告、问题输入，再到多种可能结果。网站通过引导流程和情境模拟，让抽象概念变得可体验；积极、中性和具有挑战的结果并列呈现，让用户比较情感与实际层面的影响，再自行决定。

life-ethics.en:
The central tension is that imagining a consequence may itself change how someone chooses. The team therefore framed outputs as hypothetical prompts: they should inform a decision without replacing or rushing it. Participatory input asks the user to author the material behind the twin, rather than treating passive data extraction as the default.

The poster also examines ownership of a digital self, privacy, the right to forget, misleading outputs, anxiety and dependency. Local processing is discussed as a privacy aspiration, while computational and environmental costs complicate that ambition.
life-ethics.zh:
项目最核心的张力是：对后果的预演，本身就可能改变用户的选择。因此，团队将结果定位为假设性的思考提示，帮助判断，而不替代或催促决定。参与式输入强调由用户主动提供和修订构成孪生的材料，而不是默认从生活痕迹中被动提取数据。

海报进一步讨论了数字自我的所有权、隐私、遗忘的权利、误导性输出，以及焦虑和依赖风险。本地处理被提出为保护隐私的理想方向，但计算能力与环境成本又使它变得复杂。

life-reflection.en:
In the team’s reflection, scenario-based prompts made Amelia feel more specific and revealed values more clearly than direct questions. The website, walkthrough, presentation and two-page poster communicate both the proposed experience and the ethical questions that shaped its design.

For me, the project connects user-flow design and prototyping with a more difficult responsibility: designing an AI interface that leaves room for the user to disagree.
life-reflection.zh:
团队在复盘中认为，基于情境的提示让 Amelia 更具体，也比直接提问更容易显露价值取向。网站、演示视频、演示文稿和双页海报共同呈现了体验设想及贯穿设计的伦理思考。这是定性的设计反思，并不能证明系统已经改善现实中的决策结果。

下一步可以扩大性别与文化情境，探索多人关系中的选择，并研究反复预演究竟能减少不确定，还是会加强过度分析。对我而言，这个项目把用户流程设计和原型制作，与一个更难的问题联系起来：如何设计 AI 界面，同时保留用户不同意它的空间。

sections.title: Project overview
sections.lead: Backstage is a solo-developed Unity puzzle platformer about light, shadow and dreams.
sections.originalHTML: Backstage is a solo-developed Unity puzzle platformer about light, shadow and dreams. Players inhabit a two-dimensional shadow on a theater curtain, manipulating stage lights to reshape the shadows of three-dimensional props into platforms and reach each level’s exit. The dreamlike theater follows a former stage performer confronting memories of lost glory across four progressive acts.

sections.title: From light to playable geometry
sections.lead: Moving light changes the geometry the player can stand on.
paragraphs: The core interaction follows a continuous chain: move the light, project the silhouettes of 3D objects, convert their geometry into 2D colliders, then traverse the resulting platforms.
The Shadow Projector handles real-time projection, silhouette extraction and dynamic collision generation, while the Light Controller lets players change the projection angle.
notes: Moving light changes the route itself, making observation and experimentation part of platforming.
sections.originalHTML: The core interaction follows a continuous chain: move the light, project the silhouettes of 3D objects, convert their geometry into 2D colliders, then traverse the resulting platforms. The Shadow Projector handles real-time projection, silhouette extraction and dynamic collision generation, while the Light Controller lets players change the projection angle. Moving light changes the route itself, making observation and experimentation part of platforming.

sections.title: Four levels, progressive understanding
sections.lead: Four levels progressively extend the same light-and-shadow system.
paragraphs: Level 1 introduces moving, jumping, the exit objective and the idea of existing as a 2D shadow.
Level 2 introduces horizontal light movement.
notes: Level 3 adds vertical light movement and asks players to understand projection angles.

Level 4 combines the skills learned earlier with route planning under fading light: stepping on the light-off button fades the light within five seconds, while the light-on button restores it immediately.
Each level builds on the same system rather than introducing an unrelated mechanic.

sections.title: A performer learning to leave the spotlight
sections.lead: Losing control of the spotlight gives the ending its mechanical meaning.
paragraphs: A life-changing injury forces a celebrated performer to retire.
Unable to let go, they become trapped in a surreal theater dream where memories of applause, spotlights and performances are distorted.
notes: Rehearsal revisits memory; Dressing Room expresses obsession through gaining control of the light; Opening offers the illusion of reclaiming the stage; the ending asks the player to move forward as the spotlight fades.
The intended emotional arc moves through curiosity, discovery, mastery, tension and release, connecting mechanical progression with letting go of the past.

sections.title: Three rounds of focused playtesting
sections.lead: Three test rounds connected technical reliability with learnable controls.
paragraphs: Testing progressed from technical validation to player experience and control usability.
Technical testing informed fixes to spotlight collision boundaries and intersections between 3D props and the player plane.
notes: Experience testing showed that players learned to interact with light through the levels and found the mechanic novel, with interest in further challenges.
Control testing informed clearer input guidance and movement refinements.

The iteration work addressed shadow collisions, model intersections and edge movement, added a controls guide and introductory instructions, and refined level sections for smoother navigation and flow.

sections.title: 项目概览
sections.lead: Backstage 是一款使用 Unity 独立开发的光影平台解谜游戏。
sections.originalHTML: Backstage 是一款使用 Unity 独立开发的光影平台解谜游戏。玩家化身幕布上的二维影子，操控舞台灯光，将三维道具的投影重塑为可站立的平台，寻找通往出口的路线。四幕渐进式关卡发生在梦境剧场中，讲述一位昔日舞台表演者面对过往荣光与记忆的故事。

sections.title: 从灯光到可游玩的几何体
sections.lead: 移动灯光直接改变玩家能够站立的几何体。
paragraphs: 核心交互形成连续链条：移动灯光，投射三维物体的轮廓，将投影几何转换为二维碰撞体，再利用生成的平台前进。
Shadow Projector 负责实时投影、轮廓提取与动态碰撞生成，Light Controller 让玩家改变投射角度。
notes: 灯光的移动直接改变可行走的路径，让观察和尝试成为平台跳跃的一部分。

sections.title: 四关递进的机制学习
sections.lead: 四个关卡循序拓展同一套光影系统。
paragraphs: 第一关建立左右移动、跳跃、寻找出口以及“自身是二维影子”的基本认知；第二关引入灯光左右移动；第三关加入上下移动，深化玩家对投射角度的理解；第四关综合此前技巧，要求玩家在灯光渐暗前规划路线：踩下关灯按钮后灯光会在五秒内渐暗，开灯按钮则立即恢复照明。
关卡逐步拓展同一套系统的可能性。

sections.title: 学会离开聚光灯的表演者
sections.lead: 离开聚光灯的控制，为结尾赋予机制层面的意义。
paragraphs: 一场改变人生的伤病迫使知名表演者退休。
无法放下过去的主角陷入超现实的剧场梦境，掌声、聚光灯与演出记忆逐渐扭曲。
notes: 排练对应重返记忆；化妆室通过开始控制灯光表达执念；开场让更强的灯光控制成为重获舞台的幻象；结尾则要求玩家在聚光灯消退后继续前进。
预期体验从好奇、发现、掌握，转向紧张与释然，让机制的递进承载放下过去的叙事。

sections.title: 三轮有重点的玩家测试
sections.lead: 三轮测试把技术稳定性与易于理解的操作联系起来。
paragraphs: 测试依次聚焦技术验证、玩家体验和操作易用性。
技术测试推动了聚光灯碰撞边界及三维道具与玩家平面交叠问题的修复；体验测试中，玩家通过关卡逐步理解灯光交互，认可机制的新颖性，并希望体验更多挑战；操作测试则为输入指引和移动优化提供依据。
notes: 对应迭代包括修复影子碰撞、模型交叠及平台边缘移动问题，加入操作指南和开场说明，并调整部分关卡以改善导航与通关流畅度。
